<div class="screen-controls"><p>Eight group cards plus a printable/local number line. Print one different card per group. Use the existing A1 poster for room work.</p><button onclick="window.print()">Print cards and number line</button><p><a href="Oct13_session2_review_worksheet.html">Open the worksheet</a> | <a href="Oct13_session2_board_A1.pdf">Existing A1 poster</a></p></div>

```{r, results='asis'}
html_out(paste(vapply(names(d5_cards),function(letter)paste0('<section class="claim-card"><p class="card-number">Card ',letter,'</p><h2>Twelve businesses near score 58</h2><p>Each row lists one business on each side. Compare <strong>mean annual waste management cost 12 months after GreenWaste</strong>, in AED per business.</p>',as.character(knitr::kable(d5_cards[[letter]]$rows,format='html',row.names=FALSE,table.attr='class="reading-table"')),'<p class="caption">Six city records from the GreenWaste data per side, independently sampled for this card. Costs rounded to ten AED; scores displayed to one decimal. Each business is placed on its side using its exact score, so a score above the cut-off can display as 58.0.</p><p>Find each side\'s mean, then subtract <strong>at/below minus above</strong>.</p><p>Mean at/below: __________ AED. Mean above: __________ AED.</p><p>Raw gap: __________ AED. Put your letter and gap on a sticky note.</p><div class="writing"></div><p class="caption">This small raw gap is not the fitted cut-off jump or an established effect. Record your work on worksheet Q1, page 3.</p>',if(letter=='A')'<p class="caption">GreenWaste is a fictional training case.</p>' else '', '</section>'),''),collapse=''))
```

<section class="board-page">

## Place raw gaps. Compare the fitted jump.

Use the upper lane for A-H sticky notes and the lower lane for the fitted result. Keep the comparison questions distinct.

<div class="screen-controls">
<p>Optional local board: enter group gaps, then reveal the fitted result after the explanation. Entries stay in this open browser page.</p>
<div class="rdd-inputs">
```{r, results='asis'}
html_out(paste0('<label>Card ',names(d5_cards),'<input type="number" step="any" data-card="',names(d5_cards),'" aria-label="Raw gap for card ',names(d5_cards),'"></label>',collapse=''))
```
</div>
<button id="clear-rdd-board">Clear entries</button>
<button id="reveal-rdd-fit" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="fit-marker">Show fitted estimate and interval</button>
<p id="rdd-board-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
</div>

```{r, results='asis'}
html_out(d5_board())
```
